# TermsGuard / NexusDocs.ai
> AI tool that turns contracts, terms of service, and privacy policies into plain-English summaries, privacy & legal risk flags, Q&A, and PDF reports.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://nexusdocs.ai/): Product overview and main landing page
- [TermsGuard](https://nexusdocs.ai/termguard.html): Feature details and how it works
- [Pricing](https://nexusdocs.ai/pricing.html): Free and paid plans
- [App](https://nexusdocs.ai/tg_app): The analysis tool (login required)

## What the product does
- Paste or upload a contract / terms of service / privacy policy
- Receive a plain-English summary
- See privacy and legal risk flags
- Ask follow-up questions about the document
- Export a clean PDF report

## Free tier
- 3 analyses
- 5,000 character limit
- No credit card required

## Paid plans
- Higher character limits (up to 50,000)
- Stronger AI model
- More analyses / credits

## Key value
Helps regular people and small businesses understand legal documents before they sign, without needing a lawyer for every free app or service.
